text: {"voice": 4, "model_prose": 2, "fidelity": 5, "note": "Dense with names, references, italicized Hebrew, parenthetical glosses and a colon-introduced pair, built fact to fact over a long paragraph and closing on a plain particular, so it fits the exegetical register well, though it lacks the quotation and citation apparatus and its evenly paced declaratives read slightly encyclopedic; with no propositions listed, nothing is dropped or added."}
